title: Functional Limitation
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask the walking distance in units the patient uses, such as the distance to a named shop, rather than in metres they would have to estimate.
Ask about stairs, specifically whether they are managed one at a time and whether a rail is needed.
Ask about rising from a chair, getting in and out of a car, and whether a stick is used and when it was started.
Ask about sleep, since night pain and disturbed sleep mark a different stage from activity pain alone.
Record what the patient has stopped doing, because the loss of an activity is the clearest single measure of progression.
